start.title: Tell us about your business
start.intro: From your website or a description we build your business profile, markets and competitors.
start.modeAria: How you want to tell us
start.textPlaceholder: E.g.: We sell booking software for hair salons in the US and Canada.
start.urlInvalid: Enter a valid website, for example yourcompany.com.
start.textShort: Tell us a bit more (at least 20 characters).
start.researchingHint: It can take up to a minute. Keep this tab open.

company.title: Is this your company?
company.intro: Review what we found and fix anything that is off.
company.name: Name
company.summaryHint: One or two sentences about what you sell and to whom.

customers.title: Who are your customers?
customers.intro: Where they are and which industries you sell to.
customers.marketsHint: Country and, optionally, a region or city.
customers.typesHint: The kinds of businesses you sell to.

confirm.title: Did we get it right?
confirm.offerCheck: Yes, this is what I sell

plan.title: Your plan
plan.intro: The plan belongs to your account, not to each business: all your businesses share it.
plan.activeText: {credits} credits per month. All your businesses use this plan.
plan.trialText: Use Leadta for free for {days} days. Then pick a plan to keep going.
plan.expiredText: Pick a plan to keep finding customers and sending proposals.
plan.error: We could not check your plan. You can continue anyway.

channels.title: How do we reach your customers?
channels.intro: Pick at least one channel. You can connect it now or later.
channels.whatsappText: Messages from your number, after you confirm.
channels.gmailText: Emails from your inbox, after you confirm.
channels.gmailNotConfigured: The Google connection is not available right now.
channels.later: You can connect later from Integrations.

capacity.title: Your sending capacity
capacity.intro: What your account can send with its current plan.
capacity.error: We could not load your capacity. You can start anyway.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.research_failed: We could not research your business. Check the website or try a description.
errors.invalid_request: Some data is missing or invalid. Check the form.
errors.not_found: We could not find that business in your account.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection.
